The moment your agent starts doing somethi"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ng worth knowing about — thinking, running a tool, waiting for your approval, or hitting a snag — it"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"about — thinking, running a tool, waiting for your approval, or hitting a snag — it springs to life."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## 🧭 What is this?"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"`dsh-dynamic-island` is a high-fidelity, Apple **Liquid Glass**–inspired Dynamic Island concept for "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"DeepSeek Harness. It turns the agent's inner life — thinking, tool calls, approvals, failures, compl"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"etion — into a lightweight, readable, *slightly companion-like* surface that sits on the edge of you"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"nto a lightweight, readable, *slightly companion-like* surface that sits on the edge of your screen."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"This is **not** an unrelated desktop pet. Every shape change comes from real Harness state: you alwa"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ys know whether the agent is working, what it's doing, whether it needs your call, and how the task "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"w whether the agent is working, what it's doing, whether it needs your call, and how the task ended."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## ✨ Why you'll like it"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- 🍬 **Genuine Liquid Glass** — layered transparency, springy shapes, and light that actually moves. -"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" 🤫 **Low-disturbance by design** — it stays a quiet dot until something matters. When a task complet"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"es it leaves a short receipt, then settles back down.

Nothing else."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## 🎨 The five moods"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Mood | The vibe | Tone |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| 🛰️ Idle | `agent/status: idle` — a quiet dot that says "ready when you are" | slate |

| 🛠️ Working | Teal pulse while a "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"tool runs — name and progress on screen | mint |

| `approval` | a pending approval in the composer |

| `alert` | `tool/result` error, `agent/request-error`, `turn/end {erro"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"r}` |
| `blocked` | `turn/end {blocked}` |
| `max-tokens` | `turn/end {max-tokens}` |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"On top of the eight moods, each state also carries **payload fields** (stream, tool cards, receipt, "},{"id":"p22s2","text":" moods, each state also carries **payload fields** (stream, tool cards, receipt, goal, todos, jobs):"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Island element | DSH signal |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Streaming preview (reasoning vs. answer tinted) | `assistant/chunk` (`text-delta` / `reasoning-del"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ta`) |
| Tool-command cards (exit code / duration / copy) | `tool/call.arguments` + `tool/result` |
"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"| Result receipt (files / checks / tokens / duration) | `turn/end.reason` + `assistant/message.usage"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"` |
| Goal progress ring | goal package: `roundsStarted` / round cap |
| Todo ticker + three-state c"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"hecklist | `todo/write` (whole-list snapshot, last-write-wins) |
| Background job chips | jobs packa"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"ge: `running \| stopping \| completed \| killed \| failed` + `detail` |
| Recent-wins receipt stack "},{"id":"p24s7","text":"| `turn/end` sequence |
| Model badge | `request/context` (provider · model) |
| Stop / retry / unbl"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"ock / continue | `agent/turn-stopping` / `agent/request` / goal unblock / turn resume |
